source: Zeouf BRD v1.5 and QA guide snapshot from website commit 481a090

requirements.acceptance: Home shall show women/men hero content and matching links, with one active local video or still poster, manual slide selection and pause/play. Automatic change occurs about every six seconds while at least 10% visible, tab visible, unpaused and reduced motion disabled. Offscreen/hidden/paused media stops; reduced motion uses still imagery and manual selection.
requirements.qaFocus: Active-only playback, posters, manual selection, pause, offscreen/hidden tab, reduced motion

requirements.acceptance: Two collection panels, seven category links, six editorial tiles and the blouse edit shall navigate to configured category/subcategory destinations. The compact homepage uses consistent typography/spacing and explicit demo copy; editorial tiles remain curated category links.
requirements.qaFocus: Every CTA/destination, 375/768/1440 widths, image loading

requirements.acceptance: Desktop navigation shall expose seven categories and women's/men's subcategory/highlight menus, with pointer hover and keyboard-operable expanded-state disclosure controls. Escape closes menus; closed menu links are inert.
requirements.qaFocus: Hover, disclosure click/Enter, Escape, inert links, current route

requirements.acceptance: Mobile navigation shall open/close, expose seven category links and expandable women's/men's clothing/highlight sections, and close after navigation or Escape.
requirements.qaFocus: Touch, narrow screen, subcategories, dismissal and focus restoration

requirements.acceptance: Header shall expose account, search, favorites and cart; logo returns home. Active account/cart/search/mobile dialogs lock background scrolling, contain keyboard focus, and support Escape/close/backdrop dismissal with focus restoration; closed drawers are inert.
requirements.qaFocus: Dialog roles, Tab/Shift+Tab, Escape, counts, scroll lock, focus restoration

requirements.acceptance: English URLs and their legacy redirects/rewrites shall resolve to the intended page, including mapped legacy clothing slugs.
requirements.qaFocus: Direct URL, encoded query, redirect destination

requirements.acceptance: Unknown product/subcategory routes shall reach not-found; storefront chrome shall be absent from admin pages.
requirements.qaFocus: Missing ID, route refresh, admin layout

requirements.acceptance: Listings shall restrict products to the selected category/subcategory using configured English categories and normalized matching; women's and men's collections remain distinct.
requirements.qaFocus: All 14 database categories, alias/normalization cases

requirements.acceptance: New Arrivals shall match tags containing new; Best Sellers shall match best/featured/populer tags; Collection shall include the main category. No sales ranking is implied.
requirements.qaFocus: Tags, main-category boundary, English/legacy slugs

requirements.acceptance: Brand and size filters shall use distinct values in the current collection and combine with other selected filters; missing option groups shall not show unusable selectors.
requirements.qaFocus: Single and combined filters, missing metadata

requirements.acceptance: Price filters shall apply inclusive displayed-currency min/max bounds through two sliders and suggested Under tiers; sliders shall not cross; currency changes clear price bounds.
requirements.qaFocus: Boundary prices, tier rounding, currency change

requirements.acceptance: In stock only shall keep unsized products with positive stock and sized products with available size stock; selected size shall constrain availability when stock rows exist.
requirements.qaFocus: Stock 0/1, mixed sizes, missing size rows

requirements.acceptance: Sort shall offer Recommended, Price Low to High, Price High to Low, and New Arrivals; listing price ties use name; New Arrivals prioritizes new tags then date then name. Recommended retains incoming order.
requirements.qaFocus: Equal price/date, missing date/tag

requirements.acceptance: Listing shall initially reveal at most 24 matches and load 24 more per click; count shall describe matching versus collection totals. Pending requests show Loading collection, distinct from genuine empty collections and no-filter-match results.
requirements.qaFocus: Pending request, 0/1/24/25/48/49 products, final batch, clear all

requirements.acceptance: Listing shall use local products when Supabase is unconfigured or product fetch fails. Configured product and stock operations each have an eight-second deadline and cancel on cleanup. Product failure/timeout shows identified demo fallback and Retry collection; stock-only failure/timeout retains live products with availability warning and retry. Successful retry clears feedback; a successful empty product response stays empty. Fallback browsing does not establish working order/auth services.
requirements.qaFocus: Product/stock slow, error and empty responses; timeout, cancellation, retry, genuine empty versus demo fallback

requirements.acceptance: Header search shall focus its field, trim input, ignore empty submission, encode the query, close the search UI and navigate to /search?q=….
requirements.qaFocus: Spaces, ampersand, Unicode, keyboard submit

requirements.acceptance: Results shall combine case-insensitive name and category substring queries and deduplicate by product ID.
requirements.qaFocus: Name-only/category-only/both matches, case, no matches

requirements.acceptance: Search shall show loading, query/count, results, and no-results states; explicit service-error/retry handling and clearing old results for a blank query are incomplete (G-15).
requirements.qaFocus: Slow/error responses, rapid query changes, blank after valid query

requirements.acceptance: Cards/detail shall present name, price, image, optional brand/tag/category and product links; detail uses applicable gallery thumbnails. Cards use consistent crops and responsive image sizes, show loading placeholders, and retain readable product information with Image unavailable feedback after photo failure.
requirements.qaFocus: Single/multiple/missing images, supported remote host, loading/failure state

requirements.acceptance: Verified color options shall expose named swatches and applicable images; selected color accompanies cart line. Products under /demo-products/ shall hide colors and use one demo photograph.
requirements.qaFocus: Color/image correspondence, no-color/demo fixtures

requirements.acceptance: Sized products shall require a chosen available size before add; unavailable sizes are disabled. Missing stock rows and selecting an unavailable size for an alert need resolution (G-09).
requirements.qaFocus: No size, stock 0, missing row, mixed stock

requirements.acceptance: Detail quantity shall start at one, not decrease below one, clamp to known positive available stock, and disable add/increase when the known limit is reached.
requirements.qaFocus: 1, stock limit, size change, unknown stock

requirements.acceptance: Size guide shall open/close and show XS/S/M/L chest and waist references; it is a static clothing reference, not a product-specific shoe or XL/XXL guide.
requirements.qaFocus: Overlay dismissal and reference values

requirements.acceptance: Detail shall offer one-open-at-a-time information panels for details, measurements, composition/care/origin, and shipping/exchanges/returns, using supplied text or generic fallback.
requirements.qaFocus: Open/switch/close, newline content, defaults

requirements.acceptance: Complete Your Look shall show up to eight other products whose category starts with the main category; the current product is excluded and an empty related section is hidden.
requirements.qaFocus: 0/1/8 related items, links, horizontal scroll

requirements.acceptance: In-stock unsized cards shall allow Add to bag; sized cards link to size selection; out-of-stock cards display unavailable status and omit purchase controls. Actions are visible on touch layouts and reveal on hover or keyboard focus on desktop; favorite controls remain visible with pressed state.
requirements.qaFocus: Sized/unsized/out-of-stock, guest prompt, touch/keyboard/hover actions

requirements.acceptance: Storefront shall select USD for detected US country and INR for other countries; country headers take precedence over browser fallback (India time zone, America time zone, US language).
requirements.qaFocus: Header precedence, absent country, browser fallbacks

requirements.acceptance: USD display shall convert base INR through a valid positive rate, round to whole displayed units and use en-US formatting; INR uses rate one and en-IN. Rate fetch failure shall fall back to INR.
requirements.qaFocus: Invalid/zero rate, network failure, rounding

requirements.acceptance: Cart/detail/history shall use shared currency formatting; stored prices/order totals and admin monetary displays remain base INR. Conversion is presentation and does not establish USD settlement.
requirements.qaFocus: Base versus displayed totals, rate-dependent historical display

requirements.acceptance: Register shall collect required full name/email/password and call Supabase signup with name metadata; success switches to Sign In and explains email verification when applicable.
requirements.qaFocus: Required/email validation, duplicate signup, provider policy

requirements.acceptance: Controlled password confirmation shall match the exact password before either development helper or Supabase signup. Blank confirmation is required; mismatch shows an alert and makes no create request. Confirmation clears on successful registration or account-tab change and is not sent to the provider.
requirements.qaFocus: Equal/unequal/blank confirmation, reveal toggle, request absence/payload, tab change

requirements.acceptance: Sign In shall authenticate email/password, display failure, show loading, and close account panel on session success; protected customer actions become available.
requirements.qaFocus: Valid/wrong/unverified/expired account, repeat submit

requirements.acceptance: Password visibility shall toggle in account forms without changing the entered password; Sign In/Register tabs shall be available.
requirements.qaFocus: Toggle, switch tab, stale feedback

requirements.acceptance: Forgot Password shall require entered email and request a reset email; a complete new-password recovery screen/session handler is absent (G-02).
requirements.qaFocus: No email, provider error, reset link and recovery completion

requirements.acceptance: Sign Out shall end customer session and clear in-memory favorites through auth updates; local cart currently remains.
requirements.qaFocus: Reload, protected actions, account switch/cart boundary

requirements.acceptance: Development registration may first try confirmed-user creation; on failure/unavailability it shall fall back to normal signup. Production helper shall be disabled.
requirements.qaFocus: Protected helper failure, normal signup, production

requirements.acceptance: Signed-in customers shall toggle a product favorite from card/detail; stored user/product pair is unique and successful changes update icon/count.
requirements.qaFocus: Toggle/add/remove, duplicate click, failed write

requirements.acceptance: Favorites shall load for the current user and clear on sign-out; one customer must not read/change another customer's favorites.
requirements.qaFocus: Two-account isolation, reload, direct database access

requirements.acceptance: Favorites page shall display saved product cards/count, loading, and empty Discover Collection link; visitors attempting to favorite shall get an account prompt.
requirements.qaFocus: Empty/deleted product, guest prompt, card navigation

requirements.acceptance: Add shall require a customer session; a visitor receives an account prompt without addition; successful add opens drawer. The interrupted action is not automatically replayed after login.
requirements.qaFocus: Guest/customer, post-login retry

requirements.acceptance: Lines shall be identified by product ID + size + color; missing/empty/null options normalize to null. Matching tuples merge quantities and differing options create distinct lines, including recovered legacy lines.
requirements.qaFocus: Same/different options, null/missing color, repeated add, legacy restoration

requirements.acceptance: Drawer shall show image/name/options/quantity/line total; plus/minus updates quantity; a quantity below one or explicit remove deletes the line.
requirements.qaFocus: Remove at one, variant-specific deletion, total changes

requirements.acceptance: Browser cart shall restore before writing els-cart. Malformed JSON/nonarrays recover to empty; invalid lines are removed while valid lines remain, with recovery feedback. Restored lines require nonempty display fields, supported photo URLs, finite nonnegative numeric prices, positive safe-integer quantities and valid options. Read/write storage failures keep an in-memory bag with a persistence notice. Account separation/sign-out clearing remain unresolved (G-10); no cart_items synchronization exists.
requirements.qaFocus: Initial load/reload, mixed invalid rows, duplicate variants, unavailable/quota-limited storage, two accounts

requirements.acceptance: Item badge equals sum of quantities; base subtotal equals sum of stored line price × quantity, displayed through currency formatter. Checkout determines authoritative current prices.
requirements.qaFocus: Multiple lines, rounding, changed database price

requirements.acceptance: Empty drawer shall show Start Shopping; nonempty drawer shall show Proceed to Checkout and close when navigating; cart UI currently has no upper quantity cap.
requirements.qaFocus: Empty/nonempty, close, quantity above API limit

requirements.acceptance: Order submission shall require valid customer bearer token and nonempty cart; UI disables guest/empty submission and API rejects invalid/expired sessions.
requirements.qaFocus: Guest, expired token, forged user ID, empty cart

requirements.acceptance: All five shipping fields shall be nonempty after server trimming: full name, phone, address, city, postal code; current server truncation limits in section 7 apply.
requirements.qaFocus: Missing/whitespace fields, limits, numeric-looking strings

requirements.acceptance: Request shall contain 1–50 raw item entries and each normalized variant quantity shall be an integer 1–20; duplicate tuples merge and merged quantity above 20 fails.
requirements.qaFocus: 0/1/50/51 lines, quantity 0/1/20/21/fraction, duplicates

requirements.acceptance: Checkout shall offer demo card and simulated cash on delivery, clearly state no charge/delivery, and collect/send no card details. Current card flow adds a roughly 1.2-second simulation delay; no decline branch exists. README describes these limits; the UI approval-or-decline label remains misleading (G-11).
requirements.qaFocus: Both methods, request payload, README/current UI distinction, stale UI decline copy G-11

requirements.acceptance: Server shall fetch current inventory and use database price snapshots, ignoring browser-supplied prices/totals; selected size inventory applies when size is sent.
requirements.qaFocus: Price tampering, stale price, removed product

requirements.acceptance: A successful transaction shall create one pending order and all lines with quantity, unit price, size/color; decrement inventory and set total to sum of snapshots.
requirements.qaFocus: Sized/unsized/multi-line transactions, shared color stock

requirements.acceptance: Insufficient stock at precheck or transaction shall return conflict; transaction failure shall leave no partial order/lines/stock decrement. Competing orders must not oversell.
requirements.qaFocus: Last unit concurrency, later-line failure, DB failure

requirements.acceptance: On successful returned order ID, UI shall clear cart and show confirmation/ID and Continue Shopping; API failure shall show error and keep cart.
requirements.qaFocus: Success, error response, malformed response, network rejection G-15

requirements.acceptance: Order service shall reject unsupported size/color and prevent duplicate orders from replay; current validation lacks catalog-option enforcement and idempotency (G-08, G-14).
requirements.qaFocus: Invalid option, sized item without size, repeated identical POST

requirements.acceptance: Customers shall retrieve only their own orders, newest first, including order lines; guest, loading, error and no-order states shall be distinct.
requirements.qaFocus: Two-account ownership, direct reads, empty/error

requirements.acceptance: Order cards shall show short ID, date, formatted total and status; expanding one order shows product/image, quantity, line total and payment label.
requirements.qaFocus: Expand/collapse, deleted product fallback, all statuses

requirements.acceptance: Selected size/color shall remain stored and should be visible in history/admin detail; the current views retrieve them but omit presentation (G-07).
requirements.qaFocus: Variant persistence versus rendered detail

requirements.acceptance: Review form requires nonblank displayed name/comment and stars; it sends a customer bearer token to the server review route, which stores a pending product/user/rating/comment and optional owned image URLs. Displayed name is still omitted from storage (G-03).
requirements.qaFocus: Missing fields, guest, rating 1/5, returned anonymous name, direct DB write denial

requirements.acceptance: Review upload accepts 1–3 JPEG/PNG/WebP files of 1 byte–2 MiB each for an authenticated user and existing product, checks file signatures, and limits each account to 10 upload requests per day. New files use the private review-images bucket created by the hardening migration; moderators use ten-minute signed URLs. Historical public files and orphan cleanup remain open.
requirements.qaFocus: File count/size/signature, forged MIME, invalid token/product, account limit, private bucket, signed URL expiry

requirements.acceptance: Submission keeps form data during upload/save, shows an error on failure, and clears it only after server creation. A successful pending review is acknowledged as awaiting approval and is not placed in the public list.
requirements.qaFocus: Successful pending response, upload/API/network failure, retry/data retention

requirements.acceptance: Public review API and detail query show approved rows only; database SELECT allows approved reviews or the author's own pending rows, and customer review writes are revoked. Server creation forces pending. Applied-policy/live visibility remains to be verified (G-04).
requirements.qaFocus: Visitor/customer pending visibility, direct INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE denial, approval tampering, rating consistency

requirements.acceptance: Direct /admin/reviews shall list pending reviews and let a cookie-authenticated admin approve/delete; approval records moderation time and updates database approved aggregates.
requirements.qaFocus: Valid/expired admin, approval/deletion, pending empty state

requirements.acceptance: Admin sidebar retrieves all reviews through the cookie-protected API and remains read-only; the separate pending page has moderation actions, and form results return JSON (G-05). Navigation/return flow remains incomplete.
requirements.qaFocus: Both entry paths, signed-cookie all-review list, form submission and return flow

requirements.acceptance: Admin shall be able to save/remove a reply and customers shall read persisted reply text; helper functions exist without visible reply controls and reply columns are missing from supplied schema/migrations (G-03, G-05).
requirements.qaFocus: No false success, reply persistence, public display

requirements.acceptance: Available alert UI shall accept email for an unavailable item/selected size and save product/email/size/color without customer authentication; invalid email/product shall fail. Specific unavailable-size selection is a UI gap (G-09).
requirements.qaFocus: Guest, whole-product versus size request, invalid product/email

requirements.acceptance: Email shall be trimmed/lowercased; duplicate pending product/email/size/color requests shall return already_subscribed; otherwise create one pending record and token.
requirements.qaFocus: Case, null options, concurrent duplicate uniqueness

requirements.acceptance: Response/UI shall distinguish saved-with-mail-enabled from saved-with-mail-disabled; absent delivery configuration shall keep pending requests.
requirements.qaFocus: Mail on/off, missing database, queued response

requirements.acceptance: Admin positive stock save can trigger up to 100 pending product requests, filtering by size when supplied, and mark successful sends notified; true stock/transition checks, retry scheduling and robust deduplication are incomplete (G-12).
requirements.qaFocus: Size eligibility, provider failure, repeated/concurrent batches

requirements.acceptance: GET/POST token unsubscribe shall delete the matching alert and return plain confirmation; malformed token fails, well-formed already-removed token is still successful; public clients cannot directly read the alert table.
requirements.qaFocus: Valid/repeated/malformed token, privacy/RLS

requirements.acceptance: Production admin login requires a named account with its scrypt password hash and a distinct session-signing secret; it issues a one-hour HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax cookie, Secure in production. The browser collects username/password; nonproduction may use the legacy dev key. MFA and live credential provisioning remain open.
requirements.qaFocus: Wrong username/password, missing production config, cookie claims/attributes, legacy key denied in production, MFA gap

requirements.acceptance: Server mutations/private reads shall require admin authority independent of local UI flag; product writes and reply helpers do not use that authority in current implementation (G-06).
requirements.qaFocus: Fake local flag, expired/forged cookie, customer-only session

requirements.acceptance: Sidebar logout shall POST the cookie-clearing endpoint and wait for success before removing the local flag and replacing the route with /admin. Failed requests preserve the session and display retry feedback. After successful logout the same browser's protected APIs deny access. This clears the browser cookie; copied signed tokens retain their original expiry.
requirements.qaFocus: Cookie/flag after sidebar logout, API rejection, request failure/retry, endpoint contracts

requirements.acceptance: Dashboard shall show product/stock/out-of-stock/low-stock counts, up to five newest orders, inventory warning and quick links; no-order state shall display when empty.
requirements.qaFocus: Known fixture metrics, newest five, route/sidebar state

requirements.acceptance: Admin product table shall list newest created products and combine case-insensitive name search with exact category filter, showing no-match state.
requirements.qaFocus: Search, category, combined/empty, reload

requirements.acceptance: Add/edit shall save name/category/price/overall stock/description/sizes/main image/image list and reflect persisted values; current anonymous-client writes lack admin write policies (G-06).
requirements.qaFocus: Create/edit/reload, permission denied, failed save feedback

requirements.acceptance: Product saves shall enforce nonblank name, finite nonnegative price and integer nonnegative stock; current check only ensures name/price presence and parsing (G-17).
requirements.qaFocus: Whitespace, zero, negative, fraction, invalid number

requirements.acceptance: Product image form shall append pasted URL or one uploaded image per selection, set first image as main, and promote first remaining image when one is removed; uploads use product-images bucket.
requirements.qaFocus: Multiple sequential adds, delete first/last, upload failure/host

requirements.acceptance: Sizes shall be selectable from XS–XXL and 36–44; new sized products initialize zero stock rows. Editing sizes shall synchronize rows/aggregate stock, which is currently incomplete (G-18).
requirements.qaFocus: Add/remove size, zero initialized rows, old stock

requirements.acceptance: Delete shall require confirmation and reflect actual database removal; dependent favorite/review/size/alert rows cascade and historical order lines retain price/quantity with null product. Permission/error reporting gap applies.
requirements.qaFocus: Cancel/confirm, referenced product, failed delete, history

requirements.acceptance: Stock view shall expose one row per configured size or one Overall row for unsized products; edits save on field blur through protected stock PATCH.
requirements.qaFocus: Sized/unsized, blur versus typing, expired cookie

requirements.acceptance: Stock API shall reject negative/noninteger values; size save shall upsert product/size row and recalculate product stock from all stored size rows.
requirements.qaFocus: 0/1/4/5, negative/fraction, missing/existing row

requirements.acceptance: Row labels shall be Out of stock for zero, Low stock for 1–4, Available for 5+; dashboard low-stock count currently considers sized products only.
requirements.qaFocus: Thresholds, unsized low stock discrepancy

requirements.acceptance: Size/overall inventory shall remain consistent on failures/concurrent saves; current multi-request stock update is not atomic and size membership is not enforced (G-18).
requirements.qaFocus: Failure between writes, concurrent edits, unsupported size

requirements.acceptance: Admin shall retrieve orders/lines newest first through authenticated API; table shall show ID/customer ID/INR total/status/date and View action.
requirements.qaFocus: All versus own orders, expired cookie, retrieval failure

requirements.acceptance: Order search shall match order ID or customer ID case-insensitively and combine with exact status filter, distinguishing no orders from no matches.
requirements.qaFocus: Partial ID, casing, all five statuses

requirements.acceptance: View shall open order detail with product/quantity/line totals/order total and status selector; valid status updates persist and appear in customer history on reload.
requirements.qaFocus: Open/close, update/reload, failed status change

requirements.acceptance: Allowed status values are pending/processing/shipped/delivered/cancelled; server currently permits any transition among them and cancellation restores no stock. Lifecycle/stock semantics require decision (G-19).
requirements.qaFocus: Unsupported status, backward transition, cancellation

requirements.acceptance: Admin users list shall retrieve at most 200 profiles ordered by updated_at, presenting ID/full name/update time; endpoint shall reject non-admin access.
requirements.qaFocus: No profiles, cap 200/201, permissions

requirements.acceptance: User View shall open profile detail only when implemented; current button has no handler. Editing, disabling, deleting or viewing user email are not supported flows.
requirements.qaFocus: Inert View control G-20

requirements.acceptance: Analytics shall show sum of all loaded order totals, order count, average total per order (zero when empty), and stock units in INR/base values. Cancelled orders currently contribute.
requirements.qaFocus: Known totals, zero orders, cancelled inclusion

requirements.acceptance: Order pipeline shall show count and rounded percent for each of five statuses; rounding need not sum to exactly 100%.
requirements.qaFocus: Empty and uneven status distribution

requirements.acceptance: Inventory health shall show healthy=max(products−low−out,0), low/out counts and units derived from configured sizes or unsized stock.
requirements.qaFocus: Sized-only low count, inconsistent stored rows

requirements.acceptance: Top products shall rank up to five currently existing products by quantities in all loaded orders, including cancelled orders; empty sales state shall be shown.
requirements.qaFocus: Ties, deleted product, cancelled items, no sales

requirements.acceptance: Customer signal shall show loaded review count and mean rating to one decimal, zero when empty; current calculation is not approved-only.
requirements.qaFocus: Mixed approvals, 0/1/multiple reviews

requirements.acceptance: Settings shall display store identity and catalog/category counts; database label is hardcoded. No configuration save, working feature toggles or live connectivity probe exists.
requirements.qaFocus: Read-only presentation, misleading connectivity G-21

requirements.acceptance: Footer newsletter shall require an email-shaped value, then show preview-only/no-save/no-send feedback. There shall be no implied successful real subscription.
requirements.qaFocus: Invalid/valid email, no network subscription/write

requirements.acceptance: Footer shall link all categories, favorites, privacy, terms and maintainer GitHub; information pages shall provide return-home navigation.
requirements.qaFocus: All destinations and external link attributes

requirements.acceptance: Home/checkout/privacy/terms shall explain demo limits and stored demo data; generic shipping/returns copy and confirmation wording need alignment (G-22).
requirements.qaFocus: Content consistency and fictional data guidance

requirements.acceptance: Holiday countdown component exists but is not mounted by current pages; enabling it needs scope confirmation. It counts to local-browser 31 Dec 2026 23:59:59, clamps at zero, and applies no discount.
requirements.qaFocus: Exclude from current UI pass criteria; future timer tests

requirements.acceptance: GET health shall return status ok and timestamp; it is application liveness, not a database/service readiness proof.
requirements.qaFocus: JSON and timestamp, no inferred DB health

requirements.acceptance: Test reset shall be nonproduction and test-secret protected; it attempts catalog/favorite/cart/review cleanup and reseed but omits orders/local storage and ignores delete errors (G-23).
requirements.qaFocus: Production 404, wrong secret 401, partial reset

requirements.acceptance: Test seed-user shall create a confirmed test user or reset an existing matched user's password, guarded by nonproduction plus separate test secret; inputs or configured defaults are required.
requirements.qaFocus: New/existing user, missing fields, auth/production

requirements.acceptance: Dev create-user shall be disabled in production, require x-dev-key when configured, and cap counted dev_auto users at ten; it shall not overwrite non-dev accounts.
requirements.qaFocus: Limit boundary, existing dev/non-dev, helper fallback

requirements.acceptance: Schema endpoint shall return base SQL as plain text or not-found; database-error copy action uses it. It does not include all migrations or fix the database automatically.
requirements.qaFocus: Schema available/missing, clipboard failure

requirements.acceptance: Requirements CI shall run the checked-in synchronization regression tests. Build and lint shall reject stale derived documentation, unreviewed tracked website source, or a mismatched review snapshot/log. Synchronization preserves manual fields and archives changed/retired rows; affected executed results become Needs retest. An explicit descriptive review is required to approve source changes and shall never mark tests Passed.
requirements.qaFocus: Missing snapshot, source drift, CSV manual evidence, retired IDs, repeated sync, review assertions

requirements.acceptance: npm run test:ui and test:catalog run sequential Chromium suites using dedicated localhost:3100 servers, fixture credentials and disabled live Supabase/mail integration. Catalog tests intercept a reserved .invalid domain to exercise the configured client. Existing servers are not reused; .next-browser-tests separates test compilation from ordinary development. Suite artifacts use separate directories. Configuration, test and workflow changes require documentation review; scoped mocks/local cookies are not live integration acceptance evidence.
requirements.qaFocus: Reproducible fixtures, no live mutations, cache/server isolation, configured and fallback clients, CI artifacts, source review

requirements.acceptance: npm run test:live shall run optional Chromium public-browsing checks against the deployed Vercel origin, with PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL accepting another HTTP(S) origin without credentials/path/query/fragment. No local server is launched or authenticated storage reused. The suite checks homepage, seven populated collections without fallback warnings, search, product detail, mobile navigation, information pages and admin login rendering. It blocks mutating HTTP methods and known helper/logout paths, and fails attempted writes. It does not authenticate, submit commerce/customer/admin changes or establish their acceptance. Artifacts use test-results/live; live checks remain separate from deployment-racing push CI.
requirements.qaFocus: Correct target, no local startup, public data available, state-changing requests blocked, separate artifacts and acceptance limits

requirements.acceptance: `npm run security:check-db` shall inspect the target database read-only for review RLS/grants, direct order-insert policy removal, private review bucket, limiter RLS/RPC permissions and checkout RPC restrictions. It requires an explicitly supplied `DATABASE_URL`; a pass does not replace live role tests or prove the correct deployment is connected.
requirements.qaFocus: Missing URL, correct target, pass/fail grants, bucket and policy inventory, no writes/secrets in output

requirements.acceptance: Customer-owned data and admin actions shall enforce ownership/authority server-side or in RLS; public users shall not forge totals, moderation or another customer's records. Review direct writes are removed in source, but deployed grants/policies and remaining admin product/reply writes must be verified or scoped as blockers.
requirements.qaFocus: Cross-user reads/writes, review approval tampering, fake admin flag, applied policy

requirements.acceptance: Service-role, per-admin password hashes, signing/rate-limit secrets, mail and test secrets stay server-side; QA utilities stay blocked in production. Production admin sessions use a separate signing secret and secure cookie attributes. Live environment/secret provisioning and MFA are unverified.
requirements.qaFocus: Client bundle/network/log exposure, production guards, secret separation/rotation, MFA gap

requirements.acceptance: Failed services shall show actionable feedback, preserve recoverable user state and avoid false success/partial inventory writes; fallback browsing must be distinguishable from working commerce in acceptance evidence.
requirements.qaFocus: Offline/timeout/DB/upload/provider/storage errors, retry

requirements.acceptance: Agree and verify responsive support at 375px mobile, 768px tablet and 1440px desktop, with no clipped essential controls; proposed browsers are current Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
requirements.qaFocus: Touch/hover differences, drawers, tables, horizontal scroll

requirements.acceptance: Proposed accessibility target is WCAG 2.2 AA; assess keyboard operation, meaningful labels, focus placement/trapping/restoration, contrast, announcements and reduced motion. Existing labels are not proof of conformance.
requirements.qaFocus: Keyboard-only/screen-reader audits, modal focus, hidden controls

requirements.acceptance: Agree measurable performance targets and dataset/network conditions before benchmarking; evaluate initial rendering, campaign-media weight, large catalogs and admin full-dataset reads. No current SLA is supplied.
requirements.qaFocus: Representative load, slow network, long lists, image sizes

requirements.acceptance: User-facing claims shall match demo capability; analytics shall state its population, settings must not imply live health, and stock/email order safety shall hold under concurrent operations.
requirements.qaFocus: Content, metric definitions, concurrency/replay

requirements.acceptance: Admin login, checkout, review creation/upload and restock subscription shall use one atomic production database rate-limit counter across instances; missing shared configuration/RPC fails closed with 503 on those routes. Keys are HMAC-hashed, and the ingress proxy must append or overwrite x-forwarded-for. Nonproduction may use a process-local fallback.
